text:
Alice: Heads-up: deploybot reports lease pressure on mig_4501 during tenant-range compaction at 21:07 UTC. Quiesce window active.
DeployBot: [deploybot] LEASE_PRESSURE mig_4501 shard=shard-03 inflight=18/24 lease_owner=worker-9
Brian: Oof. Can we handoff lease to standby worker? @DeployBot list handoff targets.
DeployBot: handoff_targets: worker-3, worker-12 (cold), worker-standby-1. safe_ops: handoff, pause, forced-cancel. auto-rollback if lease lost >45s
Carla: Handoff seems safest to avoid full rollback. If we pick standby-1, expect ~2s stall.
Dinesh: standby-1 is in different AZ; cross-AZ handoff might spike latency but avoid tenant rollback. fine with that.
Eve: If handoff fails, fallback plan: pause + KV snapshot + canary on subset. Also pin migration tool to release tag `infra/mig-v1.13.0` for consistency.
Alice: decision: try handoff to worker-standby-1. If handoff aborts -> immediate pause and snapshot.
Brian: initiating handoff: ```deploybot handoff mig_4501 --to worker-standby-1 --actor brian```
DeployBot: [deploybot] HANDOFF_START mig_4501 -> worker-standby-1 at 1770009998
DeployBot: HANDOFF_OK mig_4501 new_owner=worker-standby-1 latency_spike=1.9s
Carla: nice. monitoring heap and lock counts. initial inflight -> 12 after handoff.
Dinesh: still seeing intermittent lock wait on pg_shard table. watch for >20ms waits.
Eve: leaving a pinned note in release channel: "mig_4501 handoff -> standby-1; pinned infra/mig-v1.13.0; observing for 10m"
ReleaseBot: [releasebot] NOTE_PINNED mig_4501 tag=infra/mig-v1.13.0 by eve
Alice: we can proceed with canary resume at 0.25 rate. Brian please apply ratecap.
Brian: applying ratecap: ```deploybot ratecap mig_4501 --fraction 0.25 --actor brian``` -> acked
DeployBot: [deploybot] RATECAP_SET mig_4501 fraction=0.25 at 1770010012
Carla: tracing shows steady decrease in queue depth. no error spikes in traces.
Dinesh: keep an eye on lease renewals; if we see renew failures, execute pause script in runbook.
Brian: adding to release notes: "mig_4501: temporary lease handoff to standby, resumed at reduced rate; pinned to infra/mig-v1.13.0; monitors set"
Eve: will open postmortem stub and attach telemetry links. https://confluence.redwood/internal/postmortems#mig_4501
Alice: good. close thread after 15m stable. if anything regresses, escalate to oncall and initiate rollback procedure. :+1:
